steps.label: 1648-lab-math-hybrid-inline-insert-open
command: (() => {const b=document.querySelector('.tox-tbtn[aria-label="수식 입력"]');if(!b)throw Error('Observed inline math toolbar button absent');b.click();return {action:'Click TinyMCE inline math toolbar button'};})()

steps.label: 1652-lab-math-hybrid-existing-node-edit
command: (() => {const n=document.querySelector('#mre1 [data-type=inline-math]');if(!n)throw Error('Inserted inline node absent');const before=n.dataset.latex;n.click();return {action:'Click existing inline node to edit',before};})()

steps.label: 1656-lab-math-hybrid-multiline-open
command: (() => {window.tinymce.get('mre1').focus();const b=document.querySelector('.tox-tbtn[aria-label="수식 입력"]');if(!b)throw Error('Inline toolbar absent');b.click();return {action:'Open inline insert for multiline policy test'};})()
